name: syncLISData
shortDescription: Synchronizes lab information and results with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS).
description:
Overview

Synchronizes lab information and results with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS). This ensures that patient lab results are available within the portal for doctors and patients.

Intended use

This function is intended to be invoked by a scheduler (cron job) to periodically synchronize data with the LISSystem. It does not require specific parameters for invocation.

Logic

  1. Call the LISSystem external service using ctx.service('LISSystem') to fetch new or updated lab results.
  2. Iterate through the retrieved LIS data.
  3. For each lab result, identify the corresponding Patient and create or update MedicalRecord entries with the lab information using ctx.data.upsert or ctx.data.create.
  4. Audit-log the synchronization process with ctx.audit.log, noting any updates or new records.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord

External Services

  • LISSystem
